headline: 'I live for these moments': QB Daniels again delivers in clutch for Commanders

sources.name: ESPN
sources.headline: 'I live for these moments': QB Daniels again delivers in clutch for Commanders
sources.description: After failing multiple times in late-game situations earlier this season, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels put together a second consecutive game-winning drive Monday night as Washington kicked a last-second field goal to beat Cincinnati 22-20.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.headline: Dan Quinn: Scars from our late-game losses run deep, glad Jayden Daniels won it for us
sources.description: "I couldn't have been more proud of Jayden at the end of the game," Quinn said after the Commanders' 22-20 win.

sources.description: Jayden Daniels says he lives for "high-pressure situation" like the one he faced during the Commanders' comeback win over the Bengals on Monday night.
